import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['d'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%Y')
a = df[df.account_id=='rNGYton'].copy()
piv = a.pivot_table(index=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'], columns='d', values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)
# anomaly day vs prior week same weekday pattern: compare 10-20 to each of prior 7 days per resource, look for new/spike
pre = piv.loc[:, (piv.columns>='2025-10-13')&(piv.columns<='2025-10-19')]
day = piv['2025-10-20']
res = pd.DataFrame({'day':day,'pre_max':pre.max(axis=1),'pre_min':pre.min(axis=1)})
res['excess'] = res.day - res.pre_max
print(res.sort_values('excess').tail(8))

{"code": "import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['d'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%Y')
a = df[df.account_id=='rNGYton'].copy()
piv = a.pivot_table(index=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'], columns='d', values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)
# anomaly day vs prior week same weekday pattern: compare 10-20 to each of prior 7 days per resource, look for new/spike
pre = piv.loc[:, (piv.columns>='2025-10-13')&(piv.columns<='2025-10-19')]
day = piv['2025-10-20']
res = pd.DataFrame({'day':day,'pre_max':pre.max(axis=1),'pre_min':pre.min(axis=1)})
res['excess'] = res.day - res.pre_max
print(res.sort_values('excess').tail(8))
"}
